title: Escape Room Experience Area 54
blurb:
We are located in central Hamilton. Get your team together and put your detective hats on to see if you can solve the clues and puzzles to escape in 60 minutes or less......

DIFFICULTY LEVEL: 4/5

FAMILY FRIENDLINESS: 3/5

The Story:
You're a struggling journalist, desperate for a story. One night, you see some strange lights in the sky, followed by an explosion! Immediately, you start your investigations, but every lead is a dead end. Finally, you find it. A secure government site in the middle of nowhere. You watch the area and learn that all the staff leave the site for one hour every day. You have one hour to break in and find out what is going on.
